script: "My girlfriend held hands with a coworker while I was away for 2 weeks... what was going on?". So, my girlfriend, we've been dating for almost two years now, and I thought we had a solid foundation, you feel? We've talked about marriage, and I've been totally down. But, like, a few months into our relationship, I had to leave for two weeks to see my family. I offered to bring her along, but she had work and wanted to hang with her family instead. I get it, I was busy with family too, but literally, our communication was kind of meh during that time. Fast forward, I am back home, and everything seemed chill. But then, a few days pass, and she's all emotional, and I am like, what's wrong, babe? And she tells me she got super drunk at a bar with her coworkers and, like, rested her head on some guy's shoulder while gaming on the couch. I am supportive, thinking, oh, that's no big deal, just a silly night. I mean, I've been drunk in bars before too, but never like that. Cut to, like, almost two years later, and she's being all weird again, and I am like, what's going on? And then she spills the full tea – she not only rested her head, but they also held hands. Now, I am not saying it's a huge deal, but it's bothering me, you know? I am starting to think, what if she's not telling me the whole truth? We work at the same bar together every week; maybe there's more to the story. Honestly, it's freaking me out, and I feel like I've been a bit too forgiving. I mean, I am trying to work on being a better partner, but this is making me question everything. I am thinking, why did she wait so long to tell me the full story? Was it really just a drunk mistake, or was there something more going on? I am literally driving myself crazy, bestie. I guess what I am asking is, what do you guys think? Should I just chill and trust her, or is there something more I should be worried about? I am open to advice, 'cause, honestly, I am lost right now.
